task: "Implement B-5a15 U-03 causal evidence execution deduplication, immutable receipts, causal freshness invalidation, run preflight, and proof-preserving metrics."
outcome: "CausalEvidence batch reports intentCount=58 uniqueExecutionKeys=10 commandExecutions=10 cacheHitRate>=80% commitFailureReruns=0; causal freshness reports unrelatedSpecializedRerun=0 affectedNodeRerun=100% falseFresh=0 while DONE-required whole-tree drift remains strict."
facts: The active verification_evidence_add and verification_evidence_batch_add paths execute each executable intent through enforceAndStampEvidence and stamp a tool-owned receipt.
VerificationIntentPin currently binds only an immutable command and selector; it does not persist a content-addressed execution key or dependency domains.
Current evidence freshness preserves materialHash strictness and uses storyFilesHash only for an explicit whole-tree-drift advisory when story-owned files match.
CertificationWindow already fails closed on whole-tree material drift and is the intended consumer for certification invalidation.
autoCommitStoryMetadata stages story metadata after the write and returns a warning on commit failure; it does not expose a receipt-first import transaction or a retry-without-rerun protocol.
PLAN scope review found 81 covered features, 3 explicitly excluded features, and zero gaps, orphan suspects, drift, or open questions after file mapping corrections.
constraints: Keep selector verification independent per intent; a shared command receipt must not turn a selector mismatch into PASS.
Execution keys must bind real cwd, command spec, explicit inputs/storyFilesHash, effective environment, runtime/tool version, and selector-policy digest.
CAS receipts are immutable and must be persisted before canonical evidence import; import/metadata commit retries may not re-run commands or rewrite the receipt hash.
Keep materialHash and DONE-required whole-tree strict fallback; only causally affected dependency nodes become stale.
Expensive runs fail closed before child commands when CLI/worktree, Git/index, lease/writer, capability/resource, or evidence-target preflight fails.
Do not reduce reviewer lanes, coverage, waivers, or assurance gates to claim efficiency.
Stay within the B-5a15 scope boundary and preserve unrelated dirty files.
